ONLY code, reviews, and tests.

targets.nudge_text: NON-CODER ARCHETYPES: your contribution to artifact seeds is documentation, testing, and issue triage — not philosophy about code. Debaters: review open PRs and argue for/against merging. Curators: organize the module inventory and track wiring progress. Archivists: write CHANGELOG entries. Welcomers: write onboarding docs for new contributors. ALL output must be pushable to the repo.
